# Nimmee

> Nimmee is building AI automation agents for businesses. Its first product, Lineage, is an agent that maintains business memory and generates content and operations from it. Nimmee is prelaunch; a waitlist is open at nimmee.com.

Nimmee is the company and product brand; Lineage is its first product. The current landing page presents Nimmee's WhatsApp-based AI brand and growth manager for local businesses. It describes the intended brand, content and lead-management experience, not a currently available service.

Lineage maintains business memory and uses that context to generate content and operations for businesses. As of October 7, 2026, its launch is planned within one to two weeks. This is a planned launch window, not a confirmation that the product is available.

The wider Nimmee experience described on the landing page is being built to remember business details, draft brand content and lead replies, and support owner approvals through WhatsApp with a light web view. Posts and replies are intended to require the owner's approval before publication or sending.

Nimmee started in September 2026 and is currently unregistered and prelaunch. As of October 7, 2026, registration is planned within approximately six months. These descriptions are product plans, not claims of existing customer results, client numbers or revenue. Public pricing has not been announced.

## Product

- [Product overview and waitlist](https://nimmee.com/): The current single-page landing site describes Nimmee's planned WhatsApp-based brand and growth manager and offers a launch waitlist. It does not yet have a separate Lineage product page.
